title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 14
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: chăm sóc thú cưng, đặt vé máy bay, mật ong nông trại, xe nâng, lớp yoga, rạp chiếu phim, nhà ga, xưởng nội thất, Wi-Fi công viên, giặt khô, trung tâm cộng đồng, khu ẩm thực nhà ga cũ, học bổng, quán board game, webinar, giấy phép đỗ xe, chuyển văn phòng, hộp rau, nhà hát; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

NOTICE: New Residential Parking Permit Program – Eastgate Neighborhood

Beginning May 1, parking on residential streets in the Eastgate neighborhood will be limited to vehicles with an Eastgate parking permit between 8 A.M. and 6 P.M., Monday through Friday. Vehicles without a permit may park for up to two hours.

Each household may purchase up to two permits at $30 per permit per year. Visitor passes are available for $5 per day. Applications can be submitted online at www.cityofeastgate.gov/parking or in person at City Hall. Applicants must provide proof of address and vehicle registration.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: parking@cityofeastgate.gov
From: Laura Kim
Date: April 15
Subject: Parking permits

Hello,

I live on Maple Street in Eastgate, and I have two cars. I would like to apply for permits for both of them. However, one of the cars is registered at my previous address in another city, because I moved here only last month. I have updated my driver's license, but I have not yet received the new vehicle registration.

Will I still be able to get a permit for that car before May 1? Also, my parents will visit me for a week in May. How can they park near my house?

Thank you,
Laura Kim

Enjoy fresh, organic vegetables from our farm every week from June through October!

Family box (serves 3–5 people) • $40 per week

Boxes can be picked up on Wednesdays at the farm or on Saturdays at the Oakdale Farmers' Market. Home delivery is available within 10 miles of the farm for an additional $5 per week.
